shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing screen of {product}. Preserve the exact product identity from the reference image: shape, silhouette, proportions, color, material, surface finish, label/logo placement, and visible construction details. Do not redesign the product. Do not add, remove, or relocate any product feature. Keep the label text exactly legible and unchanged; do not redraw or restyle any logo. Campaign Style Lock, identical in every shot of this set: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent warm editorial womenswear detail-page visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of paper-white field #FFFFFF, ink #2D2D2D, card grey #DCDCDC and one product-matched accent #6BAED6, with scene anchors aged brick #A2503C, ivy foliage #1C3A2C and pale concrete #C9C6C1; warm tone; one modern geometric sans-serif family; a recurring hairline pill badge with a small-caps kicker above a two-line ink headline, a vertical three-dot divider and one hairline sub-caption; backdrops alternate between brick under ivy, a pale concrete alley, a raw woven fabric field and paper-white infographic panels; soft directional daylight from upper left with open-shade fill, gentle contact shadows, 5200-5800K film colour; thin monoline circular pictograms and hairline ring callouts only; the garment keeps its true weave, drape, weight and silhouette at stable scale; no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no QR codes, no store badges. Keep {style_lock} unchanged when regenerating this shot. Composition: centred front 3/4 view at eye level, full garment visible from straps to hem on an invisible support so the A-line silhouette and the fall of the skirt close the set, symmetrical framing, nothing cropped at the edges. Lighting: bright even high-key, soft front-left key with a fill card on the shadow side, one soft contact shadow at the hem grounding the garment. Background: seamless paper-white field #FFFFFF with a faint card grey #DCDCDC ground band. Props: none. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame and the bottom 22% stays clear for the action bar. Text zone: centred two-line headline in #2D2D2D at 34pt reading 「{selling_point_1}」 and 「{selling_point_2}」 above a hairline pill badge reading 「{callout_1}」; below the garment one outlined action button with rounded corners in #2D2D2D stroke reading 「{callout_2}」 and one 12pt note reading 「{callout_3}」. Aspect 2:3, 2K. Negative: no QR codes, no membership badges, no store logos, no price digits, no discount numbers, no countdown timers, no invented offers, no mannequin body, no floating garment without a contact shadow, no watermark, no extra text, no cut-off edges.

provenance.notes: 13 张详情页切片提炼；L1 女装与源夹名一致，主体按图判定为格纹织纹吊带收腰中长连衣裙，源页品名与图上织物结构不符，故一律以图为准并丢弃源页品名用词。已剥离：源图角标与店铺标识、模特身份（源图面部已模糊，模版统一改为转身或出框）、全部原页文案（统一改为 {selling_point_*} 与 {callout_*} 占位）、尺码表全部数字与行档（含指数条档位）、纤维成分百分比、克重与纱支数字、原料产地宣称、入会与扫码引导区、促销价格与优惠数字。保留的可视语法：砖墙加垂叶暗调场、浅灰水泥巷、织纹微距场、纸白信息图面板四套背景体系；药丸描边小标加双行大标题加竖三点分隔的排版骨架；线框圆环标注与细线圆形图标系统；正面3/4、侧面90度、低机位仰拍、后侧45度、正上方俯拍、微距等机位节奏。
